driver-gloves-diamondback.name: ★ Driver Gloves | Diamondback
driver-gloves-diamondback.desc:
These driving gloves offer protection from the elements while still maintaining tactile sensation. It has been crafted out of a mix of tan leather, black leather, and snakeskin.

Standard issue is for suckers... - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

specialist-gloves-blackbook.name: ★ Specialist Gloves | Blackbook
specialist-gloves-blackbook.desc: Durable, breathable, and stylish; these gloves are designed to take (and give) a beating.

sport-gloves-nocts.name: ★ Sport Gloves | Nocts
sport-gloves-nocts.desc: Synthetic fabrics make these athletic gloves durable and eye-catching.

ak-47-the-outsiders.name: AK-47 | The Outsiders
ak-47-the-outsiders.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been custom painted with crude depictions of Ts in different situations.

The Ts on the bus win rounds and rounds, rounds and rounds, rounds and rounds

ak-47-fire-serpent.name: AK-47 | Fire Serpent
ak-47-fire-serpent.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. This memento from Ruins has been painted with a fire serpent motif.

If you want to survive in the streets, learn to spit fire

ak-47-bloodsport.name: AK-47 | Bloodsport
ak-47-bloodsport.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been covered in white logo decals over a red and black hydrographic.

Co-driver wanted

aug-hot-rod.name: AUG | Hot Rod
aug-hot-rod.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has been painted with a chrome base coat and candied in transparent red anodized effect paint.

Automatic. Systematic. Hydromatic.

aug-trigger-discipline.name: AUG | Trigger Discipline
aug-trigger-discipline.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. A blue isometric pattern has been applied and finished with orange accents.

Patience is its own reward

awp-gungnir.name: AWP | Gungnir
awp-gungnir.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. Odin's spear travels down this custom painted pearlescent blue and ivory AWP.

A weapon for the Allfather

awp-desert-hydra.name: AWP | Desert Hydra
awp-desert-hydra.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. Gold snakes creep towards the barrel of this custom painted AWP. The scope, barrel, and butt stock have been painted white.

Cutting off one head means two more appear—is that a risk you're willing to take? - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

awp-black-nile.name: AWP | Black Nile
awp-black-nile.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. The lines of this custom paint job resemble grooves on a topographical map.

Bleed between the lines

awp-pit-viper.name: AWP | Pit Viper
awp-pit-viper.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been painted with a snakeskin patterned hydrographic.

I know you don't believe in the cause...and when I expose you, Valeria will have your head - The Shield and The Serpent Part 1

awp-arsenic-spill.name: AWP | Arsenic Spill
awp-arsenic-spill.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. A grey and yellow hydrographic VariCamo pattern has been applied.

Rebuilding only comes in the wake of destruction

bayonet-tiger-tooth.name: ★ Bayonet | Tiger Tooth
bayonet-tiger-tooth.desc:
Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been anodized orange and hand-etched in a tiger stripe pattern.

Like the tiger it is rare... like the tiger it is deadly...

bayonet-lore.name: ★ Bayonet | Lore
bayonet-lore.desc: Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been custom painted with knotwork.

cz75-auto-midnight-palm.name: CZ75-Auto | Midnight Palm
cz75-auto-midnight-palm.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been spray-painted with black palm fronds over a gray and purple camo.

"The sign says closed!"

desert-eagle-night-heist.name: Desert Eagle | Night Heist
desert-eagle-night-heist.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. Its base has been painted with a purple anodized map pattern. It looks like someone has drawn on top of the map since it was first applied.

Planning is one thing, executing is another

desert-eagle-heat-treated.name: Desert Eagle | Heat Treated
desert-eagle-heat-treated.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

desert-eagle-mulberry.name: Desert Eagle | Mulberry
desert-eagle-mulberry.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been painted with a deep, satin finish purple color.

"It's fuchsia, spelled f-u-c-h-s-i-a"

dual-berettas-bordeux.name: Dual Berettas | BorDeux
dual-berettas-bordeux.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. These Dual Berettas have been painted gunmetal grey. The grips have been painted a plum-colored purple.

Table for two?

dual-berettas-drift-wood.name: Dual Berettas | Drift Wood
dual-berettas-drift-wood.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has been spray-painted using brown paint in a pattern resembling dried wood.

Knock on wood; you're gonna need all the luck you can get - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

famas-faulty-wiring.name: FAMAS | Faulty Wiring
famas-faulty-wiring.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. A pattern of a wiring diagram has been applied.

Please consult an electrician before conducting your own repairs

g3sg1-high-seas.name: G3SG1 | High Seas
g3sg1-high-seas.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. It has been custom painted with a nautical theme and decorative brass metal work.

Let dead reckoning be your guide

galil-ar-grey-smoke.name: Galil AR | Grey Smoke
galil-ar-grey-smoke.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. A grayscale graphic pattern has been applied.

"Do you know how much color cartridges cost?!"

glock-18-vogue.name: Glock-18 | Vogue
glock-18-vogue.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. A pair of eyes grace the slide of this custom painted, Pop art inspired Glock.

"Look at me while I'm shooting at you!"

glock-18-ghost-protocol.name: Glock-18 | Ghost Protocol
glock-18-ghost-protocol.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been custom painted with red paint in varying sheens.

I don't care if you were followed, you're here now - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

butterfly-knife-boreal-forest.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Boreal Forest
butterfly-knife-boreal-forest.desc:
This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

butterfly-knife-scorched.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Scorched
butterfly-knife-scorched.desc:
This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

survival-knife-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Survival Knife | Doppler
survival-knife-doppler-phase-1.desc:
This multi-purpose tactical knife features a serrated edge for ripping through coarse material like bone or fiber, plus a sharp gutting hook. The composite material handle is bolted to the blade with hex nuts. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

flip-knife-freehand.name: ★ Flip Knife | Freehand
flip-knife-freehand.desc: Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been painted black and purple, then decorated with a metallic marker.

flip-knife-ultraviolet.name: ★ Flip Knife | Ultraviolet
flip-knife-ultraviolet.desc:
Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a black and purple color scheme.

Elegant design paired with brutal intent

gut-knife-stained.name: ★ Gut Knife | Stained
gut-knife-stained.desc:
The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.

If you think it's messy now, wait until you see it under a blacklight

gut-knife-case-hardened.name: ★ Gut Knife | Case Hardened
gut-knife-case-hardened.desc:
The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

shadow-daggers-tiger-tooth.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Tiger Tooth
shadow-daggers-tiger-tooth.desc:
Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been anodized orange and hand-etched in a tiger stripe pattern.

Like the tiger it is rare... like the tiger it is deadly...

shadow-daggers-lore.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Lore
shadow-daggers-lore.desc: Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been custom painted with knotwork.

bowie-knife-night.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Night
bowie-knife-night.desc:
This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a night ops color scheme.

It's the whisper of the wind... it's the bite at your neck

huntsman-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler
huntsman-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-1.desc: A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

ursus-knife-stained.name: ★ Ursus Knife | Stained
ursus-knife-stained.desc:
This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work. It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.

If you think it's messy now, wait until you see it under a blacklight

ursus-knife-case-hardened.name: ★ Ursus Knife | Case Hardened
ursus-knife-case-hardened.desc:
This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

m4a4-the-coalition.name: M4A4 | The Coalition
m4a4-the-coalition.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. A custom gold and black paint job with interlocking triangles and blue highlights has been applied.

This alliance is temporary, but you're making me reconsider…

m4a4-naval-shred-camo.name: M4A4 | Naval Shred Camo
m4a4-naval-shred-camo.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. A blue tiger camo pattern has been applied.

Endangered no more

m4a4-etch-lord.name: M4A4 | Etch Lord
m4a4-etch-lord.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been custom painted to appear as if it was etched into.

It's just a phase

mac-10-aloha.name: MAC-10 | Aloha
mac-10-aloha.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been airbrushed with a red hibiscus pattern.

For the noncommittal

mac-10-allure.name: MAC-10 | Allure
mac-10-allure.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. A woman in teal, believed to be iso onna, stands before koi fish and crashing waves on this custom painted MAC-10.

Beauty begets bloodshed

mac-10-strats.name: MAC-10 | Strats
mac-10-strats.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. A hydrographic pattern of the 51st floor's construction, HVAC, and wiring plans has been applied.

All according to plan…

mac-10-video-cam.name: MAC-10 | Video Cam
mac-10-video-cam.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been custom painted to resemble a handheld camera.

REC...

mag-7-sonar.name: MAG-7 | Sonar
mag-7-sonar.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has been lightly stenciled in turquoise.

You're right, losing is a new experience for me – The Oni and The Valkyrie Part 2

mp7-fade.name: MP7 | Fade
mp7-fade.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

negev-dev-texture.name: Negev | dev_texture
negev-dev-texture.desc:
The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. It has been custom painted with an orange base and grey developer textures.

hammer.exe time

negev-calicamo.name: Negev | CaliCamo
negev-calicamo.desc:
The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. It has been painted using a VariCamo patterned hydrographic.

Rebuilding only comes in the wake of destruction

nova-ocular.name: Nova | Ocular
nova-ocular.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. This custom paint job features simple geometric shapes and realistic details inspired by abstract surrealism and the works of 20th century artists.

Eyes of the beholder

p250-see-ya-later.name: P250 | See Ya Later
p250-see-ya-later.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been custom painted with a green, mechanized croc with yellow detailing.

In a while…

p250-visions.name: P250 | Visions
p250-visions.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been custom painted with a vibrantly colored design.

One crow short of a murder

p250-epicenter.name: P250 | Epicenter
p250-epicenter.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. This custom paint job gives the appearance of custom machined parts using an anodized finish.

Direct impact

sawed-off-black-sand.name: Sawed-Off | Black Sand
sawed-off-black-sand.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been custom painted with a tan and black military camo pattern.

Mikah did not account for highly motivated opposition

sawed-off-spirit-board.name: Sawed-Off | Spirit Board
sawed-off-spirit-board.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been custom painted to resemble a heavily played spirit board.

"Come on, I know you're moving it..."

scar-20-carbon-fiber.name: SCAR-20 | Carbon Fiber
scar-20-carbon-fiber.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. It has been painted using a carbon fiber hydrographic over a graphite base coat.

Just because I carried my team doesn't mean it wasn't a team effort - Rona Sabri, Rising Star

scar-20-jungle-slipstream.name: SCAR-20 | Jungle Slipstream
scar-20-jungle-slipstream.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. It has been custom painted with a green and yellow hydrographic.

Create your own wake

sg-553-lush-ruins.name: SG 553 | Lush Ruins
sg-553-lush-ruins.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. Ancient gods are obscured in the background of this foliage-adorned pattern.

"Eyes up everyone—we're being watched..."

ssg-08-blood-in-the-water.name: SSG 08 | Blood in the Water
ssg-08-blood-in-the-water.desc: The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been airbrushed with the image of a shark.

tec-9-ossified.name: Tec-9 | Ossified
tec-9-ossified.desc: An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been painted using a transparent lime green abstract hydrographic over a metallic base coat.

usp-s-forest-leaves.name: USP-S | Forest Leaves
usp-s-forest-leaves.desc: A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been spray-painted using leaves as stencils.
